fields.note: The CR-1457 step rule gives aramid (Vc 3.1-3.5) the optimistic gamma 1 and aluminium (Vc 0.5-0.6) the conservative 0.2. Applied to both families, 018's optimistic curve (PROJECTION) gives aluminium 0.847 against aramid 0.609 on the optimistic line, 0.924 against 0.650 at 5% and 0.988 against 0.685 at 0%, where aluminium is capped by Be face compression. 018's conservative curve gives 0.557 against 0.253, 0.617 against 0.270 and 0.669 against 0.284. 'Aramid leads' on every margin line rests on the mixed pairing. The budgets were not re-solved under the curves.
